extruded.description: Extrude the polygon based on getElevation. Prefer disabling extrusion over returning 0 from getElevation.

fillColor.description: Fill color as RGB or RGBA, channels 0-255.

lineColor.description: Outline color as RGB or RGBA, channels 0-255.

getPolygon.description: Arrow function of one record, d. Returns the polygon ring.

getElevation.description: Arrow function of one record, d. Returns the extrusion height in meters. Only used when extruded is true. If omitted, every polygon uses 1000 (deck.gl default).

symbologyState.description: Grammar symbology for fill, stroke, and line width. Deck.gl accessors are derived at render time. fillColor, lineColor, and lineWidthMinPixels apply when a channel is unset.

layers.description: Grammar rendering layers. Each layer is an independent rendering pipeline with optional preprocess transforms and encoding rules.
